notes: Capture, level, evolve, rarity tiers, raid bosses and a currency economy make this an RPG first; the hundreds of secret caves, easter eggs, lore pages and treasure hunts are Adventure doing real work, so it is named second. Shape is world-open-biomes because the themed zones with their own enemies and escalating difficulty are the world's structure, but its P4 is overridden to P0 on the author's answer that the zones are contiguous regions of one island, with portals reserved for the temporary Rift worlds — keeping the shape and dropping the split it assumes. Preset Action RPG keeps all four of its options with the shape swapped off world-hub-dungeon for the same reason, and adds collectible-nodes, teleporter-link for the portals, and settlement-density for Sigma City. With no user to ask I scoped the build to the two zones the answer names, read Skibidi Sewers as an open sunken sewer district adjacent to the city rather than tunnels beneath it, and deferred the P3 housing interiors, the P4 Reality Rift worlds and the P2 secret caves to later passes.
